answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by pricing identity with locked work-bonds: before any vote weight unlocks, a key must keep a living garden of stamped challenge answers across several epochs and a bonded deposit that grows with attestation load. When a sudden delta of lookalike joins shares funding paths, the protocol nullifies the whole cluster together. The fable is simple—one actor in many masks still pays many bonds plus idle capital time—so mass forgery costs more than honest tending before panels ever grade the spam.
